 LIVE UPDATES NBA Cleveland Cavaliers vs. New York Knicks Live NBA Updates, Scores and Highlights
 Dan Favale Nov 11, 2026, updated just now 
 The New York Knicks play host to the Cleveland Cavaliers on Wednesday night in what will be the second Eastern Conference Finals rematch of the season.
 Last time, the reigning NBA champs took care of business rather easily. And they are rolling overall. The Knicks enter having won four straight and six of their last seven.
 Cleveland, meanwhile, is struggling to find its footing. The Cavs have lost four of their last five, the most recent of which was a meltdown against the reeling Charlotte Hornets.
 Will the Knicks stay hot or will the Cavs climb out of this mini rut? Follow all the latest updates, highlights, analysis and takeaways from this one below!
 Live Updates
 40 Total Posts
 Newest First ​ Just Now 09:27 PM Vintage Beard
 Maybe James Harden hasn't entered active retirement after all. In what's easily his best game of the season, he's up to 30 points on 9-of-13 shooting...in just 29 minutes.
 Score: Cavs 104, Knicks 101 | 4:20 remaining in the fourth quarter 
 Just Now 09:25 PM Karl-Anthony Towns Did WHAT?! 🎥
 This has to be one of the five coolest passes of Karl-Anthony Towns' career.
 Just Now 09:23 PM The Knicks Offense at Its Best
 Ball and body movement are beautiful.
 5 mins ago 09:22 PM Karl-Anthony Towns Makes Knicks History
 Just in case joining Willis Reed's company isn't enough, Towns also happens to be two assists shy of a triple-double.
 9 mins ago 09:18 PM Kenny Atkinson is Tightening Up the Cavs' Rotation
 One question still remains: Will the Cavs close with both bigs or just one of them? Evan Mobley is currently the only one on the floor right now.
 Score: Cavs 99, Knicks 92 | 6:57 remaining in the fourth quarter 
 12 mins ago 09:15 PM Donovan Mitchell is a Cheat Code 🎥
 The Knicks have been aggressively trapping Donovan Mitchell basically ever since this play. Let's see how it works out for them.
 Score: Cavs 97, Knicks 90 | 7:33 remaining in the fourth quarter 
 18 mins ago 09:09 PM The Duel We've Been Waiting For
 OK, so maybe not. But Donovan Mitchell is up to 23 points on 6-of-7 shooting inside the arc, while Deuce McBride has 17 points off the Knicks bench after drilling 5-of-7 three-point attempts.
 Following a 5-0 run to open the fourth from New York, Cleveland is off to the races once more. 
 Score: Cavs 89, Knicks 83 | 9:57 remaining in the fourth quarter 
 22 mins ago 09:05 PM Knicks-Cavs Summary After Three Quarters
 New York's vaunted Wingstop trio of Mikal Bridges, Josh Hart and OG Anunoby is a combined 3-of-9 from the floor with five turnovers. That'll be among the biggest stories coming out of tonight if the Knicks lose.
 James Harden coming alive has been huge for the Cavs. He was helped along in the third by Donovan Mitchell and Tyrese Proctor. Evan Mobley remains quiet, but Cleveland's three-point shooting and free-throw advantage are offsetting it.
 Score: Cavs 82, Knick 76 | End of the third quarter 
 28 mins ago 08:59 PM Josh Hart Got T'd Up 😂
 Josh Hart almost showed restraint here. 
 Now we have to wait and see whether the NBA forces him to wash his mouth out with soap as a penance.
 31 mins ago 08:56 PM A Cavaliers Twist None of Us Saw Coming
 This is impressive on one hand. Meleek Thomas was drafted No. 34 overall last June and Tyrese Proctor was scooped up at No. 49 in 2025. Good for them.
 On the other hand, Jaylon Tyson is supposed to be the Cavs' second-best wing—that guy who can come in behind (or alongside) Peyton Watson to provide defensive energy and floor-spacing. 
 If Proctor and Thomas have, in fact, squeaked past him in the effectiveness pecking order, Cleveland has some tough questions to ask itself leading into the trade deadline.
 34 mins ago 08:53 PM Jalen Brunson Nearly Sends Peyton Watson Flying into the Stands
 Peyton Watson really wanted his third three-point block of the night, huh?
 39 mins ago 08:48 PM Cleveland Finally Ends an 11-0 Knicks Run
 The Cavs needed this one from Tyrese Proctor. They hadn't scored in roughly four minutes at this point.
 Following a Deuce McBride corner three, the game is now tied.
 Score: Cavs 74, Knicks 74 | 3:37 remaining in the third quarter 
 42 mins ago 08:45 PM James Harden vs. OG Anunoby Got Weird
 This is the same energy as two brothers fighting over the PS5 controller.
 47 mins ago 08:40 PM No-Look Dime from Jalen Brunson 👀
 Good thing the fake-out didn't fool OG Anunoby. 
 Because it sure has anything got me.
 Score: Cavs 69, Knicks 64 | 6:40 remaining in the third quarter 
 49 mins ago 08:38 PM Jalen Brunson Hits His 1,000th Triple 🎥
 Ranking Jalen Brunson's top-three career achievements:
 This
 Winning a title
 Winning Finals MVP
 Looks about right, no?
 50 mins ago 08:37 PM Jalen Brunson is a Charge-Drawing Superstar
 Great question here from James L. Edwards III of The Athletic. 
 Relatedly, Brunson is once again in the top five of total charges drawn—as he has been in all of his seasons with the Knicks.
 53 mins ago 08:34 PM James Harden is the Cavs' Skeleton Key
 This is the risk Cleveland always ran when they flipped Darius Garland for a more durable, yet decade-older, James Harden. 
 Fortunately for the Cavs, while The Beard doesn't have blow-by chops anymore and has seen his foul-drawing bandwidth slip, he should still stabilize as an off-the-dribble three-point shooter and pick-and-roll passer.
 Score: Cavs 69, Knicks 60 | 8:43 remaining in the third quarter 
 1 hour ago 08:22 PM Jalen Brunson Joins Exclusive Company
 Jalen Brunson's 13-point first half wasn't especially loud, but anytime you join a list that reads like a who's who of All-NBA scorers and floor generals, you're something many things right.
 1 hour ago 08:20 PM James Harden Comes Alive to Close the Half
 James Harden dropped 13 points on 4-of-4 shooting in the second quarter to help the Cavs stem a couple of big pushes from the Knicks. Cleveland was able to expand the lead to six points with a closing-kick flurry.
 Limiting their turnovers (five) and the Knicks' offensive rebounding opportunities (three) went a long way for the Cavs. They have to do a better job containing Karl-Anthony Towns (15 points, four assists) on drives and not letting him dice them up with passes to cutters. But their guards were largely able to keep Jalen Brunson (13 points, three assists) in check.
 Score: Cavs 59, Knicks 53 | Halftime 
 1 hour ago 08:13 PM This is Why the Cavs Traded for Peyton Watson
 With two more blocks on three-point attempts tonight, Peyton Watson is now the league leader in such swats for the season. 
 1 hour ago 08:08 PM Karl-Anthony Towns = Unguardable
 When Towns is hitting these ultra-deep or trail threes, defenses don't stand a chance.
 Speaking of which, the Knicks are up to five made threes in the second quarter alone. Cleveland's lead is just about gone.
 Score: Cavs 50, Knicks 49 | 2:39 remaining in the second quarter 
 1 hour ago 08:06 PM Cavs Found the Next...Jordan Clarkson?
 Jordan Clarkson has been great for the Knicks, but the Big Apple version of him is an offensive rebounding and defensive try-hard who gets into the paint. Meleek Thomas is more like early-aughts JC, but with better touch from the perimeter.
 1 hour ago 07:59 PM KAT is Causing a Social Media Frenzy
 Anyone else starting to think the Knicks should have done more to lock up Karl-Anthony Towns on an extension before the season started? 
 New York reportedly offered him somewhere between $45 million and $50 million. He apparently wants more. And he's playing like it. 
 1 hour ago 07:53 PM KAT isn't Messing Around
 Or as the kids would say: KAT IS TOO TUFF .
 1 hour ago 07:51 PM Karl-Anthony Towns is Heating Up
 Karl-Anthony Towns has opened up the second quarter with excellent energy. He's attacking on offense, moving on defense and continuing to throw bodies around near the glass. 
 KAT is now up to 10 points in just 11 minutes. The Knicks are within two as a result.
 Score: Cavs 34, Knicks 32 | 9:24 remaining in the second quarter 
 1 hour ago 07:49 PM Landry Shamet > Mikal Bridges?
 This won't have any impact on how many people plug Mikal Bridges into their preferred trade machine. Nope, nope, nope, certainly not.
 1 hour ago 07:44 PM Grown Adult Finish by Karl-Anthony Towns
 Kudos for Karl-Anthony Towns' power when turning a corner, but the Cavs defense parted like the Red Sea for him on this one.
 1 hour ago 07:42 PM Cavs Take a 10-Point Lead into the Second Quarter
 Cleveland built the lead with a good amount of shot-making off the bench. Meleek Thomas and Tyrese Proctor combined for 13 points, and the Cavs as a team are shooting 69-plus percent inside the arc.
 Score: Cavs 33, Knicks 23 | End of the first quarter 
 1 hour ago 07:36 PM The Cavs' Rookie is a Human Bucket
 Meleek Thomas has been hitting shots like this all season. How did he slip all the way to No. 34?!
 Score: Cavs 25, Knicks 16 | 1:51 remaining in the first quarter 
 1 hour ago 07:30 PM Fancy Footwork from Donovan Mitchell
 Spida didn't incorporate his high pickup dribble into this one, but we'll let that slide.
 2 hours ago 07:24 PM The Cavs Need More of This From Peyton Watson
 Peyton Watson has looked as advertised on defense a lot of the time this season. But his sub-25 percent clip from three isn't going to cut it in this offense.
 Especially if James Harden really is entering his washed era.
 Score: Cavs 10, Knicks 9 | 6:31 remaining in the first quarter 
 2 hours ago 07:21 PM James Harden is About to Go Off 😤
 LOL, JK.
 2 hours ago 07:18 PM Josh Hart Looks Hobbled
 We are officially off, and Josh Hart may have already re-aggravated his right ankle injury. New York isn't taking him out, though, so maybe he's just getting his sea legs back.
 Score: Cavs 4, Knicks 4 | 9:13 remaining in the first quarter 
 2 hours ago 07:11 PM 'The Cavs Suck' -Charles Barkley
 Never change, Chuck. 
 2 hours ago 07:09 PM The Knicks are (Sort of) Adding a Former Top-10 Pick
 Rob Dillingham has not shown much since being drafted eighth overall in 2024. But he can be shifty on the rock, and in the absence of a second primary ball-handler, the Knicks like to have a bunch of competent secondary decision-makers. 
 Viewed through this lens, getting Dillingham into the same program that has helped reboot Landry Shamet's career and continued developing Tyler Kolek is a solid flier. 
 2 hours ago 07:02 PM Yeah, the Cavs Have Problems
 Here's more evidence that Charles Barkley is right.
 You can make the case that Evan Mobley spends a lot of time playing away from the basket. But it doesn't really excuse the returns when you look at how other teams with perimeter-oriented bigs still crash the offensive glass.
 Cleveland, in fact, is playing one of them tonight. The Knicks remain the NBA's best offensive rebounding squad despite losing Mitchell Robinson to the Boston Celtics and having Karl-Anthony Towns run offensive sets from above the free-throw line.
 2 hours ago 06:52 PM Charles Barkley Has a Point About the Cavs
 Despite having both Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen, the Cavs rank in the bottom 10 of both offensive and defensive rebounding rate.
 Granted, Allen's absence has skewed these returns. But Cleveland is still a below-average team on the defensive glass with both bigs on the floor and rates in the 3rd percentile of offensive rebounding to boot.
 2 hours ago 06:44 PM The Cavs Reveal Their Starting 5 
 Having your usual starters isn't typically a big deal. But because of injuries to Peyton Watson and Jarrett Allen, this is just the second time since Halloween Cleveland's preferred fivesome will be available. 
 2 hours ago 06:37 PM 'Law & Order SVU' Star Signs Autographs
 Do we think they realize this guy also plays basketball, too?
 3 hours ago 06:23 PM Josh Hart is Back
 After missing two games with an ankle injury then one more with an illness, Josh Hart returns to the Knicks' rotation. With Karl-Anthony Towns also getting the green light, this allows New York to roll with its usual starting five of Hart, KAT, Jalen Brunson, Mikal Bridges and OG Anunoby.
